lines.t:
An <c:ffff00>act<c> that transforms a transformable <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c> into
its <c:ffff00>{{medachange_form}}<c>. <c:ffff00>{{part|pl|cap}}<c> with "-C" in their <c:ffff00>model<c>
<c:ffff00>number<c> are designed to {{transform}}; they are required
in all 4 <c:ffff00>slots<c>, in <c:ffff00>{{original|cap}}<c> configuration.
Requires none of the 4 slots to be <c:ffff00>destroyed<c> and
the <c:ffff00>{{charge_gauge}}<c> at 20% or more. The higher the
<c:ffff00>{{medal_level}}<c>, the faster <c:ffff00>{{prep}}<c> and <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c> are.
It uses 10% of the {{charge_gauge}} and clears all
<c:ffff00>negative statuses<c>.
